entries.title: Songs of Syx
entries.definitive_edition: Songs of Syx on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use a native desktop build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Songs of Syx is officially distributed on Steam, GOG, and itch.io, with the Windows build listed alongside macOS and Linux. Windows PC is the safest primary route because it has the current storefront-supported PC build and avoids the extra platform-specific Java/runtime caveats that can affect macOS or Linux.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Early Access release through Steam, GOG, or itch.io.

entries.remaster_caveats: Songs of Syx is still in active development/Early Access; the official site also offers a free version that can lag the paid build by several months.
